basic_info.description: Welcome to an Inner Parkside gem perfectly situated near West Portal shops and restaurants, Taraval Street shops, MUNI lines, 19th Avenue buses, and top-rated schools. This well-maintained home features a spacious, bright living room with a cozy fireplace and a formal dining room ideal for gatherings. The newly remodeled kitchen includes a charming breakfast nook, blending style and functionality. Two comfortable bedrooms at the rear overlook a serene backyard, with a deck off the master bedroom offering a private outdoor retreat. Freshly painted inside and out, this residence exudes modern elegance and is thoughtfully upgraded with a solar energy system and a new heat pump for efficient heating and air conditioning, providing both comfort and sustainability. The lower level provides a full garage with tandem parking for three cars, combining convenience with an excellent location. Experience comfortable, eco-friendly, and stylish living in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
